name: vonage
description: Vonage: send SMS and WhatsApp (text, image, templates, custom) through the Messages API, Number Insight and balance; agent sends need an opt-in and an E.164 recipient allowlist

nodes.title: Number Insight
nodes.description: Number Insight v1: basic (format, country; free), standard (+ carrier, ported) or advanced (+ validity, reachability, roaming); standard and advanced are billed per request (as agent tools only when VONAGE_TOOL_ALLOW_INSIGHT=1)

number.description: Number in international format (or national with country)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country for a national number, e.g. ID

cnam.description: Caller name for US numbers (standard/advanced; extra charge)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Account balance
nodes.description: Account balance in EUR and whether auto-reload is on

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send SMS
nodes.description: Send an SMS (paid per segment; Vonage answers 202 with message_uuid) (as an agent tool only when VONAGE_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1)

from.description: Sender: your Vonage number in E.164 or an alphanumeric sender id where allowed

ttl_seconds.description: Give up delivery after this many seconds

client_ref.description: Your reference (up to 100 characters), echoed in status webhooks

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp text
nodes.description: Send a WhatsApp text (only inside the 24-hour customer care window; paid) (as an agent tool only when VONAGE_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1)

from.description: Your WhatsApp Business number, E.164 with +

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp image
nodes.description: Send a WhatsApp image from a public URL (inside the 24-hour window; paid) (as an agent tool only when VONAGE_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1)

from.description: Your WhatsApp Business number, E.164 with +

client_ref.description: Your reference (up to 100 characters), echoed in status webhooks
